packet.description_seed: TechCrunch has followed SpaceX's start, struggles, and successes from the early days. And we're here for what happens next too. This package of SpaceX IPO coverage includes who stands to win (and maybe some who won't), pre-IPO deals, and what's tucked inside its S-1 registration document.

what: SpaceX IPO: Live updates on everything you need to know

clean_source_blocks.text: Tesla stock stands at $396.24 at the time of writing. It has dropped over 8% in the last month and 13% over the last six months. Wall Street speculation of a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla is intriguing for investors interested in owning shares of both companies through a potential new entity. Tesla stock is down 9% from its Jan. 2 share price of $438.07. It's up about 24% year-over-year. Key developments for 2026 include the introduction of the Model Y Juniper and the Cybercab, Tesla's robotaxi service. The Model 3 sedan and Model Y electric SUV remain two of the best-selling electric vehicles in the country and two of the most competitive EVs available globally.

SpaceX is selling shares to the public for the first time on June 12 for an initial public offering (IPO) price of $135 a share. It's raising nearly $75 billion by selling 555.6 million shares, according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing. The American aerospace manufacturer was founded by Tesla CEO Elon Musk in 2022. Companies that Musk is involved in frequently collaborate, and many expect a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX. The SpaceX IPO is the largest in history. Here's what Tesla fans and investors need to know about how SpaceX's IPO could impact Tesla stock. SpaceX now trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. Its stock ticker is SPCX. Retail investors and institutional buyers can purchase shares of SpaceX stock.

The American aerospace manufacturer opened trading at $150 a share. Its share price rocketed to over $168.00 before noon, surging over 22% so far, making it extremely volatile. Its percentage gains are out-performing Nasdaq market movers like Seagate Technology Holding (STX), Intel Corp (INTC), and more on June 12. Tesla owns a whopping 19 million shares of SpaceX stock, says Yahoo Finance. Large percentage changes in SpaceX's share price will greatly impact Tesla's investment in the company. Additionally, many retail investors could sell Tesla stock shares to free up capital and purchase SpaceX shares.

Musk said the Optimus humanoid robot could be its "biggest product ever" and stopped production of the Model S and Model X to make room to produce the robots. It has been a transformative year for Tesla in terms of developing products and services for the future. SpaceX's IPO could be exciting for Tesla fans, but it's too soon to tell how it will impact Tesla's share price or affect the company in the long run. Tesla makes the Model 3 el ---

original_article.research:
[Lähde: TechCrunch]
SpaceX has captured the attention of media, investors, and the public for years now — interest propelled by the company’s reusable rocket launches, the rise of its Starlink satellite network, and of course, for its founder and CEO Elon Musk.

But in its 24-year history, nothing quite compares to this initial public offering. Everyone seems to be interested, and perhaps it’s because of the sheer size of this IPO. The company priced its 555.6 million shares at $135 each to raise $75 billion, making it the largest IPO in history. At this price, the deal also looks set to make Musk the world’s first trillionaire.

---

[Lähde: USA TODAY]
SpaceX is selling shares to the public for the first time on June 12 for an initial public offering (IPO) price of $135 a share. It's raising nearly $75 billion by selling 555.6 million shares, according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing.

The American aerospace manufacturer was founded by Tesla CEO Elon Musk in 2022. Companies that Musk is involved in frequently collaborate, and many expect a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX.

The SpaceX IPO is the largest in history. Here's what Tesla fans and investors need to know about how SpaceX's IPO could impact Tesla stock.

SpaceX now trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. Its stock ticker is SPCX. Retail investors and institutional buyers can purchase shares of SpaceX stock.

The American aerospace manufacturer opened trading at $150 a share. Its share price rocketed to over $168.00 before noon, surging over 22% so far, making it extremely volatile.

Its percentage gains are out-performing Nasdaq market movers like Seagate Technology Holding (STX), Intel Corp (INTC), and more on June 12.

Tesla owns a whopping 19 million shares of SpaceX stock, says Yahoo Finance. Large percentage changes in SpaceX's share price will greatly impact Tesla's investment in the company. Additionally, many retail investors could sell Tesla stock shares to free up capital and purchase SpaceX shares.

Tesla stock stands at $396.24 at the time of writing. It has dropped over 8% in the last month and 13% over the last six months. Wall Street speculation of a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla is intriguing for investors interested in owning shares of both companies through a potential new entity.

Tesla stock is down 9% from its Jan. 2 share price of $438.07. It's up about 24% year-over-year. Key developments for 2026 include the introduction of the Model Y Juniper and the Cybercab, Tesla's robotaxi service.

The Model 3 sedan and Model Y electric SUV remain two of the best-selling electric vehicles in the country and two of the most competitive EVs available globally.

Musk said the Optimus humanoid robot could be its "biggest product ever" and stopped production of the Model S and Model X to make room to produce the robots. It has been a transformative year for Tesla in terms of developing products and services for the future.

SpaceX's IPO could be exciting for Tesla fans, but it's too soon to tell how it will impact Tesla's share price or affect the company in the long run.

[Lähde: AOL]
Elon Musk-led rocket and AI company SpaceX soared in trading on Friday, moving well above an initial public offering (IPO) price of $135 per share.

The stock price clocked at about $173 a share on Friday afternoon, seting the value of SpaceX at more than $2 trillion. The IPO, the largest of all time, made SpaceX one of the world's six largest companies by market capitalization.

The IPO made Musk the first trillionaire, vaulting the world's richest person further ahead of other financial titans. The second-wealthiest person alive, Google founder Larry Page, holds a net worth of $291 billion, according to Forbes.

SpaceX, Anthropic: What to know about this year's blockbuster IPOs

Here's what to know about the SpaceX IPO.

Why is SpaceX moving forward with an IPO?

The IPO would pull in fresh funds for the Texas-based firm, which oversees Musk's ambitions in the fast-growing but cost-intensive AI industry. The company aims to raise as much as $75 billion from its public listing.

Founded in 2002, SpaceX builds and operates spacecraft, including thousands of satellites deployed in support of its Starlink satellite internet service.

In February, the company merged with xAI, a Musk-led AI company that offers a chatbot in competition with the likes of OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude. OpenAI and Anthropic recently filed paperwork to become publicly traded companies.

SpaceX touted the merger with xAI as a key step in its plan to launch a fleet of "orbital data centers," satellites designed to deliver computing power, much like their terrestrial counterparts.

The company's revenue jumped to $18.7 billion in 2025, soaring 33% compared to the previous year, a financial filing showed. Nearly a quarter of that revenue came from Starlink, which counted millions of subscribers. Still, SpaceX failed to turn a profit, registering a loss of $4.9 billion last year.

Will the SpaceX IPO make Elon Musk a trillionaire?

The wealthiest person alive is set to become even richer.

Musk boasts a net worth of about $780 billion, according to Forbes. The SpaceX IPO could vault Musk's wealth well beyond $1 trillion.

The company's founder and CEO is set to own roughly 42% of SpaceX shares after the IPO. If SpaceX were to achieve its target valuation of $1.75 trillion, Musk would accrue hundreds of millions of dollars in new wealth, at least on paper.

However, Musk cannot sell any of his SpaceX shares until a year after the IPO, according to a financial filing.

payload.title: SpaceX aloitti pörssikaupan rajulla nousulla
payload.summary: SpaceX:n osakkeet tulivat julkiseen kaupankäyntiin 12. kesäkuuta, ja yhtiö tavoittelee listautumisellaan lähes 75 miljardin dollarin varainhankintaa. Ensimmäiset kaupankäyntitunnit olivat voimakkaan nousun ja suuren heilunnan sävyttämiä.
payload.content:
SpaceX:n osakkeet tulivat julkiseen kaupankäyntiin 12. kesäkuuta 135 dollarin listautumishinnalla, ja yhtiö pyrkii keräämään lähes 75 miljardia dollaria myymällä 555,6 miljoonaa osaketta. Osake aloitti kaupankäynnin Nasdaq Global Select Market -markkinapaikalla tunnuksella SPCX, ja ensimmäiset tunnit toivat sijoittajille poikkeuksellisen nopeita kurssiliikkeitä.

## Osake nousi heti listautumisen jälkeen

SpaceX:n osake avasi kaupankäynnin 150 dollarissa eli selvästi listautumishinnan yläpuolella. Ennen puoltapäivää kurssi oli käynyt yli 168 dollarissa, mikä merkitsi yli 22 prosentin nousua listautumishintaan verrattuna.

Nousu teki osakkeesta erittäin volatiilin heti ensimmäisenä kaupankäyntipäivänä. Kurssikehitys ylitti samana päivänä useiden Nasdaqin seurattujen yhtiöiden, kuten Seagate Technologyn ja Intelin, prosentuaaliset liikkeet.

Listautumisen mittakaava on suuri: yhtiön ilmoitetaan keräävän lähes 75 miljardia dollaria osakemyynnillä. Osakkeita voivat ostaa sekä yksityissijoittajat että institutionaaliset sijoittajat.

## Vaikutuksia seurataan myös Teslan kautta

SpaceX:n listautuminen kiinnostaa erityisesti Teslan seuraajia, koska yhtiöiden ympärillä on pitkään ollut sijoittajaspekulaatiota mahdollisista kytköksistä ja yhteistyöstä. Elon Musk on keskeinen hahmo molempien yhtiöiden ympärillä, ja Muskiin liittyvien yritysten yhteistyö on lisännyt odotuksia markkinoilla.

Teslan osake oli kirjoitushetkellä 396,24 dollarissa. Se oli laskenut yli 8 prosenttia kuukaudessa ja 13 prosenttia kuuden kuukauden aikana, mutta oli yhä noin 24 prosenttia korkeammalla kuin vuotta aiemmin. Vuoden alun 438,07 dollarin tasosta Teslan osake oli noin 9 prosenttia alempana.

Teslan kerrotaan omistavan 19 miljoonaa SpaceX:n osaketta, joten SpaceX:n voimakkaat kurssiliikkeet voivat vaikuttaa Teslan sijoituksen arvoon. Samalla markkinoilla arvioidaan, että osa yksityissijoittajista saattaa myydä Tesla-osakkeitaan vapauttaakseen pääomaa SpaceX:n ostamiseen.

Pitkän aikavälin vaikutus Teslaan on silti vielä epäselvä. Tesla kehittää samaan aikaan uusia tuotteita ja palveluja, kuten Model Y Juniperia, Cybercab-robotaksipalvelua ja Optimus-humanoidirobottia. SpaceX:n pörssidebyytti voi lisätä kiinnostusta Muskin yhtiöihin, mutta sen pysyvä vaikutus Teslan osakekurssiin ja liiketoimintaan selviää vasta myöhemmin.
summary_bullets: SpaceX:n osakkeet tulivat julkiseen kaupankäyntiin 12. kesäkuuta 135 dollarin listautumishinnalla.
Yhtiö tavoittelee lähes 75 miljardin dollarin varainhankintaa myymällä 555,6 miljoonaa osaketta.
Osake avasi 150 dollarissa ja nousi ennen puoltapäivää yli 168 dollariin.
Teslan omistus SpaceX:ssä ja sijoittajien mahdolliset siirrot tekevät listautumisesta merkittävän myös Teslan kannalta.

Osake avasi 150 dollarissa ja nousi ennen puoltapäivää yli 168 dollariin.
Teslan omistus SpaceX:ssä ja sijoittajien mahdolliset siirrot tekevät listautumisesta merkittävän myös Teslan kannalta.

article.source_text:
Tesla stock stands at $396.24 at the time of writing. It has dropped over 8% in the last month and 13% over the last six months. Wall Street speculation of a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla is intriguing for investors interested in owning shares of both companies through a potential new entity. Tesla stock is down 9% from its Jan. 2 share price of $438.07. It's up about 24% year-over-year. Key developments for 2026 include the introduction of the Model Y Juniper and the Cybercab, Tesla's robotaxi service. The Model 3 sedan and Model Y electric SUV remain two of the best-selling electric vehicles in the country and two of the most competitive EVs available globally.

SpaceX is selling shares to the public for the first time on June 12 for an initial public offering (IPO) price of $135 a share. It's raising nearly $75 billion by selling 555.6 million shares, according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing. The American aerospace manufacturer was founded by Tesla CEO Elon Musk in 2022. Companies that Musk is involved in frequently collaborate, and many expect a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX. The SpaceX IPO is the largest in history. Here's what Tesla fans and investors need to know about how SpaceX's IPO could impact Tesla stock. SpaceX now trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. Its stock ticker is SPCX. Retail investors and institutional buyers can purchase shares of SpaceX stock.

The American aerospace manufacturer opened trading at $150 a share. Its share price rocketed to over $168.00 before noon, surging over 22% so far, making it extremely volatile. Its percentage gains are out-performing Nasdaq market movers like Seagate Technology Holding (STX), Intel Corp (INTC), and more on June 12. Tesla owns a whopping 19 million shares of SpaceX stock, says Yahoo Finance. Large percentage changes in SpaceX's share price will greatly impact Tesla's investment in the company. Additionally, many retail investors could sell Tesla stock shares to free up capital and purchase SpaceX shares.

Musk said the Optimus humanoid robot could be its "biggest product ever" and stopped production of the Model S and Model X to make room to produce the robots. It has been a transformative year for Tesla in terms of developing products and services for the future.
